description: This PHP class defines a MatcherLocation model within the Goteo project. It manages location data associated with a matcher, including methods to retrieve instances and check user permissions.

classes.name: MatcherLocation
classes.description: A model class representing location data for matchers, with methods to retrieve data and check user permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the matcher property.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a MatcherLocation instance based on a matcher or ID.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks if a given user has permission to view this location.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a given user has permission to edit this location.
